(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [14,15]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:PT8.makeAI({n:7,classes:['B','A'],skill:.88,rally:false}),rolling:true,trackRace:true});const T=RACE.T,h=RACE.cars[0];const sp=[],lat=[];let gT=null,ex=0,after=null;for(let i=0;i<60*40;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';if(i%60==0){sp.push(Math.round(h.sp*3.6));lat.push(+PT8.latOf(T,h).toFixed(1))}if(RACE.green&&gT==null){gT=+RACE.t.toFixed(1);after={fa:!!h.forceAI,gaps:RACE.cars.map(k=>Math.round(k.unw*T.sp)).sort((a,b)=>b-a),spd:RACE.cars.map(k=>Math.round(k.sp*3.6))}}RACE.cars.forEach(k=>{if(k.exp>0&&!k._e){ex++;k._e=1}})}out[tr]={st:RACE.state,cd:RACE.cd,t:RACE.t,gT,after,ex,sp:sp.join(' '),lat:lat.join(' '),pop:h.pop};PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
